name: transcritranslator
description: Stream Deck plugin: voice dictation — records the microphone, transcribes it at OpenAI and pastes into the focused field (optionally translating).

scripts.mic: esbuild test/mic-check.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=node_modules/.cache/mic.mjs --log-level=error --banner:js="import{createRequire as ___cr}from'node:module';const require=___cr(import.meta.url);" && node node_modules/.cache/mic.mjs
